text:
oliver: Heads-up  NovusAI agreed to a 20-30m case interview + written Q&A next Thurs 10:00am PT. Need legal on quote clearance, logo permission, and an embargo window. Also want webinar signups routed to an SDR queue 'novus-webinar'. Can legal + demand gen confirm timelines?

mae: I'll draft the case copy and social snippets. Please paste any verbatim lines the customer used so legal can pre-check.

oliver: Verbatim candidates from last call (will ask them to repeat on mic):
"Moving to Redwood Dedicated cut our 95th-percentile latency from ~400ms to ~240ms under peak load."
"Batching and KV cache lowered our GPU spend by about 42% in initial tests."
"Rollout was seamless  we launched without any rollback windows."

courtney: Flagging the percent claim  legal will need a snapshot or written confirmation. Logo use requires a signed logo release; name + quotes okay with written permission. If they don't provide numbers, public copy should use conservative language like 'significant reduction'. I can draft a one-paragraph release and a short redaction checklist.

nina: For lead routing, sample webhook payload (auth token omitted):
```
POST /hooks/sfdc HTTP/1.1
Host: hooks.redwood.example
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "source": "novus-webinar",
  "email": "{registrant_email}",
  "first_name": "{registrant_first}",
  "last_name": "{registrant_last}",
  "utm_campaign": "novus-launch",
  "target_queue": "Novus Webinar"
}
```

mae: We'll make a gated appendix for exact metrics and keep the public claim conservative. That should satisfy legal if they want numbers behind a form.

oliver: Customer requested embargo: earliest publish 2026-09-01 08:00 PT. Courtney, can you confirm sign-off by 8/28 EOD?

courtney: Yes, I'll review quote text today and send a redlined package. Will prepare the release and ask them to sign it on the calendar event.

ops-bot: Calendar invite "NovusAI case interview" created by oliver for 2026-08-24 10:00 PT. Recording enabled.

oliver: Great  I'll update the launch playbook with: legal sign-off owner @courtney, release owner @oliver, landing page + webhook owner @nina. Will ping when assets are uploaded. :rocket:
